name: Followers Teleport Too
summary: When you are teleported by a command, tamed pets that are standing (not sitting) near you are teleported to the same destination. Sitting pets stay put. Pets are briefly protected from damage after arriving.

mechanics.title: Pet teleport
mechanics.description: Before a command teleport happens, the mod checks for non-sitting followers around the player and moves them to the destination.

mechanics.title: Arrival protection
mechanics.description: By default followers take no damage for 20 seconds after the teleport (config disableFollowerDamageAfterTeleport, durationInSecondsDamageShouldBeDisabled), preventing fall or suffocation damage from an imprecise landing spot.

vanilla_changes.change: Vanilla leaves pets behind when you teleport; now non-sitting tamed pets come with you.

getting_started: Nothing to do: have your pets stand (unsit them) and use a teleport command, such as the pack's homes/spawn/back datapacks.
editor_notes: Only triggers on command-based teleports. Whether the pack's homes/spawn/back datapacks use /tp (and so trigger this) should be verified in-game.
